cards.card_text: The Pharisees and scribes say Jesus' disciples break the tradition of the elders.
cards.verse_text: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders?
cards.snippet: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders?

cards.card_text: Why they break God's command for their tradition Why they came all this way to ask about hands Why they never wash their own hands either
cards.verse_text: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
cards.snippet: …do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?

cards.card_text: Jesus sums it up: the Pharisees and scribes nullify the word of God for the sake of their tradition.
cards.verse_text: Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
cards.snippet: Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

cards.card_text: The Gospel of Mark explains that some people don't eat until they wash their hands ceremonially, holding to the tradition of the elders.
cards.verse_text: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.
cards.snippet: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat…

cards.card_text: And they have many other traditions, like washing cups, pitchers, kettles and even couches for dining.
cards.verse_text: And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
cards.snippet: And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and…

cards.card_text: Why they skip the elders' tradition Why they work on the Sabbath Why they don't fast like others
cards.verse_text: So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders?
cards.snippet: …scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders?

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says it plainly to the Pharisees and scribes: they've disregarded the ___ of God to keep the tradition of men.
cards.verse_text: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.”
cards.snippet: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.”

cards.card_text: He goes on, “You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.” Neatly, friend.
cards.verse_text: He went on to say, “You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.
cards.snippet: …“You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.

cards.card_text: Jesus says that by the tradition they've handed down, they nullify the word of God, and they do so in many such matters.
cards.verse_text: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down.
cards.snippet: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down.

cards.card_text: Remembering him and keeping the traditions he passed on Sending gifts to help with his travels Ending all the quarrels among them
cards.verse_text: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
cards.snippet: …I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.

cards.card_text: He says he was extremely ___ for the traditions of his fathers.
cards.verse_text: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
cards.snippet: …Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

cards.card_text: Then Paul gets serious: don't let anyone take you captive through philosophy and empty deception, based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world.
cards.verse_text: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
cards.snippet: …you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.

cards.card_text: Paul says this philosophy and empty deception is based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on ___.
cards.verse_text: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
cards.snippet: …you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.

cards.card_text: After all this about the Day of the Lord, Paul tells the brothers to stand ___ and cling to the traditions he and his team taught them.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
cards.snippet: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says the traditions he and his team taught the Thessalonians came to them only by speech.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
cards.snippet: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
